challenge_description.name: Two Days Gone
challenge_description.all_names: Two Days Gone, Running Down a Dream, Eve 6, Paddle Out
challenge_description.description: Players are divided into pairs. Players throw a ball into a bucket which then rolls down a ramp. They must catch it at the other end before it drops but running through a rope obstacle. Then they much balance a ball on a paddle and pass to each other and land the ball into a net. They then must untie a set of puzzle pieces and complete a puzzle bridge. First three pairs move onto the next stage. The final stage they must retrieve a ball from a cage by balancing the ball on a paddle and work together. They then must manouvre the ball through a table maze. The first pair to finish win immunity.

challenge_description.name: Wrist Assured
challenge_description.description: ontestants hold a handle attached to a rope, keeping a bucket filled with 25% of their body weight suspended in the air. As the challenge progresses, the rope unwinds, making the weight harder to hold until only one survivor remains.
